claim: Security Hub CSPM uses service-linked AWS Config rules to run security checks for most controls, and you must enable AWS Config and record resources for it to generate most control findings; other controls use custom Lambda functions that Security Hub CSPM manages and that need no prerequisites.

qualifiers.condition: most controls; some controls use Lambda functions managed by Security Hub CSPM

evidence.quote: Security Hub CSPM uses service-linked rules from AWS Config to run security checks for most controls.
You must enable AWS Config and record resources in AWS Config for Security Hub CSPM to generate most control findings.
Other controls use custom Lambda functions, which are managed by Security Hub CSPM and don't require any prerequisites.
